fleet-console-panel.title: Server console
fleet-console-panel.description: Open a terminal to a fleet node in the browser. The panel signs a short-lived Guacamole token for the node; the node password stays on the server inside that token. Only a company owner can open a console.
fleet-console-panel.empty: No fleet servers are registered yet. Register the first node below.
fleet-console-panel.registryUnreadable: The fleet registry could not be read.

host-disk-settings-panel.title: Host disk
host-disk-settings-panel.thresholdLabel: Alert when the disk is fuller than, %
host-disk-settings-panel.hint: The signal appears in the attention queue when usage crosses this level. Applies immediately; the sweep re-reads it on every measurement.

maintenance-settings-panel.title: Maintenance
maintenance-settings-panel.description: While a window is open, new agent runs in its scope do not start, wakes queue up, routines and watchdogs pause. Running runs finish; after the drain timeout they keep running or are interrupted and retried after the window ends.
maintenance-settings-panel.windowStats: {{reason}} · running {{running}} · queued runs {{queuedRuns}} · queued wakes {{queuedWakes}} · interrupted {{interrupted}}
maintenance-settings-panel.onTimeoutInterrupt: Interrupt running runs and retry them after maintenance

processes-settings-panel.unavailable: Process settings are unavailable right now.
processes-settings-panel.title: Processes of the board
processes-settings-panel.description: How the board is split across processes. Saving applies the setting without restarting the server; the mode in force is reported by each process when it starts, and PAPERCLIP_PROCESS_MODE=single on the server starts it as one process whatever this page says.
processes-settings-panel.saveError: Could not save the process settings: {{error}}
processes-settings-panel.apiCountInvalid: Api processes must be a whole number between 1 and 4.
processes-settings-panel.apiCountHint: How many api processes a split board runs (the recommended arrangement is one worker and two api processes). Source: {{source}}.
processes-settings-panel.leaseInvalid: The leader lease must be a whole number of seconds between 5 and 600.
processes-settings-panel.leaseHint: How long the background role holds the leader lease before it has to renew it. Source: {{source}}.
processes-settings-panel.busHint: Where live events travel when the board runs as several processes. Source: {{source}}.
processes-settings-panel.admissionHint: Where run admission is decided. Source: {{source}}.
processes-settings-panel.proxyLabel: Proxy single-process routes to the leader
processes-settings-panel.proxyHint: A process that is not the leader proxies the routes that must run once (the scheduler, the background timers) to the process that owns them. Source: {{source}}.

session-generations-settings-panel.thresholdError: {{label}}: enter a whole number from 1 to 1000000
session-generations-settings-panel.title: Task session generations
session-generations-settings-panel.description: A container bot keeps one session per task. Once a session passes either limit below, the next wake starts a fresh session and carries the task summary and a handoff note into it, so the bot's state stops growing with the task. Saving applies on the next wake, without a restart. Turning the switch off keeps every task on its current session.
session-generations-settings-panel.enabledLabel: Start a fresh session when a limit is passed
session-generations-settings-panel.maxMessagesHint: A session that recorded more runs than this rolls over. Default {{value}}.
session-generations-settings-panel.maxDaysHint: A session older than this many days rolls over. Default {{value}}.
session-generations-settings-panel.saveFailed: Saving the session generation settings failed.
session-generations-settings-panel.loadFailed: Failed to load the session generation settings.

workspace-hygiene-settings-panel.quotaInvalid: Enter a whole number above 0, or leave it empty for no cap
workspace-hygiene-settings-panel.workspaceQuotaHint: Disk ceiling for one execution workspace, megabytes. Over it, the workspace is asked to clean up — at most once a day.
workspace-hygiene-settings-panel.totalQuotaHint: Disk ceiling for the sum of the measured workspaces of one company, megabytes. Over it, the company gets one signal.
workspace-hygiene-settings-panel.title: Workspace hygiene
workspace-hygiene-settings-panel.description: Disk ceilings for agent execution workspaces. The sweep measures each workspace on its tick and signals “clean up” when a ceiling is crossed — it never deletes anything. Every value applies without a restart; an empty field means the cap is off. Environment variables stay the default for an instance that never saved a row here; each field shows where the value in force came from.
workspace-hygiene-settings-panel.nothingMeasured: Nothing measured yet — the sweep fills these numbers on its tick.
workspace-hygiene-settings-panel.saveFailed: Saving the workspace hygiene quotas failed.
workspace-hygiene-settings-panel.loadFailed: Failed to load workspace hygiene settings.
